purpose: Teach: 瓩/屬/璽/錣/註/楼/个/北村

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 物流伝票の旧単位、瓩、つまりキログラム表記を統一しましょう
lines.en: Let's standardize the old unit notation on these shipping documents — 瓩, kilogrammes, across the board.
lines.style: Businesslike and clear. Brisk opening. Direct instruction without hesitation. Efficient pace, like moving through a checklist. Slight emphasis on 'standardize' as the actionable goal.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。旧字「屬」、つまり属の組織図を更新します
lines.en: Got it. I'll update the organizational chart to reflect the old character 屬 — the proper form for our structure.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Quick, steady response. Cooperative tone without obsequiousness. Slight pause before clarifying the detail, showing he's listened carefully.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 公式文書の璽、つまり社印の使用ルールを整理しましょう
lines.en: And let's clarify the usage rules for the company seal — 璽 — in all official documents.
lines.style: Directing with quiet authority. Even tempo. Slight emphasis on 'clarify' as the organizing principle. Calm, methodical delivery, like laying out the next necessary step.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。資料館の錣、つまり兜の付属品を点検します
lines.en: Understood. I'll do an inspection of the fittings on the old armor displays — the 錣 components in the gallery.
lines.style: Prompt, reliable response. Steady pace. A touch of care in acknowledging the specificity of the task. Not rushed, but clearly ready to move forward.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 契約条項の註、つまり註記をベテランに確認しましょう
lines.en: Let's have one of the senior staff review the annotations in the contract clauses — the 註 marks especially.
lines.style: Directive tone, measured. Slight pause before specifying 'annotations' to signal the emphasis. No urgency, but clear priority. Trusting in Kenji to understand the importance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新しい高楼、つまりタワー型オフィスの内覧を予定します
lines.en: Right. I'll schedule a tour of the new tower-style office building with you when I have his availability.
lines.style: Efficient confirmation. Direct, almost matter-of-fact. Slight downward inflection at the end, like checking off a list. No extra flourish — just the next action.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 旧台帳の个、つまり個の表記を読み解きましょう
lines.en: And let's work through the old ledger notation — the 个 character usage — so we're reading it correctly.
lines.style: Clear instructional tone. Calm, methodical pacing. Slight emphasis on 'work through' to suggest collaborative problem-solving. Confident but not abrupt.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。北村取締役のご都合を伺います
lines.en: Understood. I'll check on Director Kitamura's schedule and get back to you.
lines.style: Final acknowledgment. Polite, concise closing. Steady, unhurried pace. Slight falling tone at the end, signaling the end of the list. Professional but warm.
